quests.title: A Foundation That Remembers
quests.synopsis: Audit the oldest cathedral bulkhead and choose which founding compromise should remain visible.
quests.canonImpact: Establishes how civic construction records contested history.

quests.title: The Blank Sector
quests.synopsis: Recover three contradictory beacons and decide whether a hidden route belongs on the public atlas.
outcomes: A hidden sector is mapped or protected
quests.canonImpact: Changes the accessible route graph and Cartographers Guild policy.

quests.title: Under the Forbidden Sun
quests.synopsis: Join a prohibited survey and return evidence before the Errant's failing drive strands the expedition.
quests.canonImpact: Reveals evidence that challenges a Council travel ban.

quests.title: The Last Honest Keel
quests.synopsis: Trace a run of defective alloy before a newly built rescue ship enters service.
quests.canonImpact: Creates a permanent provenance record for the affected ship class.

quests.title: The Missing Predecessor
quests.synopsis: Find the absent receipt between two famous events without erasing the uncomfortable testimony it contains.
quests.canonImpact: Adds a disputed founding event to all connected history browsers.

quests.title: Entangled Debt
quests.synopsis: Repeat a failed QATAAUM experiment and determine whether the result was sabotage or an honest anomaly.
quests.canonImpact: Unlocks or delays a propulsion branch.

quests.title: The Reef Is a Witness
quests.synopsis: Protect a sentient microbial reef while determining who altered its habitat controls.
outcomes: A new citizen species may be recognized
quests.canonImpact: Changes biosphere law and synthetic-life classification.

quests.title: Fourteen Minutes of Air
quests.synopsis: Coordinate a pressure emergency where saving one deck may isolate another inhabited section.
outcomes: Lives, trust, and station access change
quests.canonImpact: Records the player's command decisions in station history.

quests.title: The Empty Holds
quests.synopsis: Investigate a manufactured food shortage before panic buying spreads across the station.
outcomes: Food prices and trader reputation change
quests.canonImpact: Alters the local shortage curve and sanctions list.

quests.title: An Honest Raid
quests.synopsis: Board a seized relief freighter and decide whether its legal owner or stranded passengers deserve the cargo.
quests.canonImpact: Creates precedent for salvage under emergency conditions.

quests.title: Three Voices, One Border
quests.synopsis: Negotiate a border accord among a swarm, a living ship, and a human mining cooperative.
outcomes: A peaceful route or blockade emerges
quests.canonImpact: Defines multispecies transit rights in Kestrel.

quests.title: The Personhood Test
quests.synopsis: Defend a station subsystem that claims citizenship after refusing an unsafe command.
quests.canonImpact: Sets a legal precedent consumed by every connected project.

quests.title: CARTO's Hidden System
quests.synopsis: Operate the observatory with CARTO and turn uncertain signals into a verified exploration contract.
quests.canonImpact: Adds a durable route and discovery record.

quests.title: Fleet on the Anvil
quests.synopsis: Help FORGE prioritize scarce components across rescue, defense, and civilian ships.
quests.canonImpact: Propagates repair choices into missions and trade demand.

quests.title: BOB Cannot See
quests.synopsis: Restore camera and logistics coverage without granting BOB authority over private quarters.
outcomes: BOB becomes a stronger ally or a constrained rival
quests.canonImpact: Changes station surveillance coverage and BOB trust.

quests.title: The Shortage Wave
quests.synopsis: Use FLUX forecasts to prevent a component shortage or profit from it at social cost.
quests.canonImpact: Records player influence over the live production chain.

quests.title: A Dying Light Speaks
quests.synopsis: Follow NOVA's supernova warning and identify an artificial signal inside the stellar event.
outcomes: A new anomaly mission chain begins
quests.canonImpact: Introduces a persistent stellar event to Nacre.

quests.title: The Reactor Teaches Back
quests.synopsis: Repair a power oscillation while ENKI teaches the player a permanent advanced crafting technique.
outcomes: Crafting unlock and station power stability
quests.canonImpact: Adds a learned recipe to player continuity.

quests.title: The Crime Between Cameras
quests.synopsis: Investigate a cargo theft using testimony, drone records, and gaps in BOB's coverage.
outcomes: Security trust and criminal pressure change
quests.canonImpact: Creates a remembered accusation and legal evidence trail.

quests.title: Enter the History Room
quests.synopsis: Use LEDGE to replay a sealed emergency and recover a detail overlooked by the original witnesses.
outcomes: Historical context unlocks a present mission
quests.canonImpact: Adds a non-destructive annotation to a permanent event.

quests.title: Cooling Song
quests.synopsis: Repair a residential coolant loop while preserving the vibration pattern residents use as a daily time signal.
quests.canonImpact: Preserves a small station tradition.

quests.title: The Last Loaf Contract
quests.synopsis: Help a baker secure grain without accepting a predatory shortage contract.
outcomes: Food supply and neighborhood trust improve
quests.canonImpact: Changes basic food pricing for one cycle.

quests.title: The Loose Panel
quests.synopsis: Investigate a maintenance panel that keeps opening after every documented repair.
outcomes: A maintenance tunnel secret is found
quests.canonImpact: Adds an accessible hidden passage.

quests.title: Open Channel
quests.synopsis: Protect a community broadcast from interference without handing editorial control to station command.
quests.canonImpact: Changes which world events residents hear first.

quests.title: Medic in Transit
quests.synopsis: Find a delayed medical courier before temperature-sensitive treatment expires.
outcomes: A patient survives and remembers the rescue
quests.canonImpact: Creates a rescue memory and clinic supply change.

quests.title: A Body of My Choosing
quests.synopsis: Help Kiri obtain an embodiment without accepting an ownership clause hidden in the lease.
quests.canonImpact: Adds a synthetic ownership precedent.

quests.title: Refuse Erasure
quests.synopsis: Recover Palimpsest's archived memories before a maintenance order overwrites them.
quests.canonImpact: Extends continuity protections to maintenance archives.

quests.title: The Machine Shift
quests.synopsis: Mediate a work stoppage by machines asked to exceed their agreed heat limits.
outcomes: Factory output and machine loyalty change
quests.canonImpact: Creates machine labor standards.

quests.title: Spare Self
quests.synopsis: Decide whether an old navigation core is a spare part or Vela Rho's separated sibling.
outcomes: A new machine citizen may join
quests.canonImpact: Defines continuity rules for forked machine minds.

quests.title: Static in the Choir
quests.synopsis: Tune a habitat field so Ion can speak clearly without disrupting station sensors.
quests.canonImpact: Adds a translation profile shared across systems.

quests.title: Hull Race Rescue
quests.synopsis: Turn an illegal hull race into a rescue when debris cuts off the return route.
quests.canonImpact: Changes hull access policy and local reputation.

quests.title: Stolen Air
quests.synopsis: Trace missing oxygen reserves without blaming the low-gravity quarter that reported the loss.
outcomes: Air supply and neighborhood trust change
quests.canonImpact: Adds atmosphere theft to the station crime history.

quests.title: Seedfall
quests.synopsis: Recover microgravity seeds scattered through a ventilation shaft before they damage the ecosystem.
quests.canonImpact: Preserves a space-adapted food lineage.

quests.title: The Second Lung
quests.synopsis: Test an adaptive organ treatment while defending Pax's right to withdraw consent.
quests.canonImpact: Creates a consent standard for engineered citizens.

quests.title: Night Bloom
quests.synopsis: Find why a protected nocturnal organism blooms only during reactor instability.
outcomes: A biological reactor sensor is discovered
quests.canonImpact: Links biosphere behavior to engineering diagnostics.

quests.title: Weather Skin
quests.synopsis: Repair a settlement weather membrane using Jenna's living material without exploiting its pain response.
quests.canonImpact: Adds a humane construction method.

quests.title: Door Older Than Maps
quests.synopsis: Open a precursor door whose warning names the station before the station existed.
objectives: Choose whether to open the door
outcomes: A precursor chamber opens or remains sealed
quests.canonImpact: Changes the accepted chronology of Aurora settlement.

quests.title: The Seventh Name
quests.synopsis: Recover the name Threnody surrendered to survive a precursor archive collapse.
quests.canonImpact: Adds a precursor testimony to the WORM.

quests.title: A Ship's Hunger
quests.synopsis: Feed Ilyra the rare minerals she needs without stripping a protected asteroid habitat.
outcomes: Ilyra's health and route range improve
quests.canonImpact: Adds living-ship nutrition to the economy.

quests.title: A Solo Voice
quests.synopsis: Help one hull voice speak apart from the vessel choir without breaking their shared identity.
quests.canonImpact: Defines individual expression within collective vessels.

quests.title: One Body, Many Votes
quests.synopsis: Resolve whether a swarm citizen receives one vote or one vote per independent quorum.
quests.canonImpact: Sets voting precedent for distributed persons.

quests.title: The Lost Member
quests.synopsis: Recover a separated swarm member carrying memories the larger quorum cannot reconstruct.
quests.canonImpact: Adds a branching swarm memory record.

quests.title: A Shadow for Lux
quests.synopsis: Build a low-radiation room where Lux can rest without disappearing from station sensors.
quests.canonImpact: Adds an accessible habitat type.

quests.title: Borrowed Flare
quests.synopsis: Return stellar energy Helio absorbed during an emergency before it destabilizes the reactor grid.
outcomes: Reactor reserve and Helio trust change
quests.canonImpact: Creates energy-entity power exchange rules.

quests.title: The Route Kept Oral
quests.synopsis: Earn permission to record a nomad route without turning sacred knowledge into a commodity.
outcomes: A protected route may enter the atlas
quests.canonImpact: Adds cultural permissions to navigation data.

quests.title: A Debt Across Stars
quests.synopsis: Settle an inherited caravan debt whose original creditor no longer exists as one person.
outcomes: Debt, trade trust, and caravan access change
quests.canonImpact: Sets succession rules for multispecies contracts.

quests.title: Garden on the Hull
quests.synopsis: Establish a vacuum-tolerant memorial garden without obstructing station repair routes.
quests.canonImpact: Adds a persistent memorial to the station exterior.

quests.title: The False Signature
quests.synopsis: Prove that a cargo contract was forged before Sima loses her ship and crew.
quests.canonImpact: Adds a fraud pattern to contract verification.

quests.title: The Quiet Shaft
quests.synopsis: Reopen a mine after its workers report a sound that does not appear on instruments.
outcomes: Mining output or habitat protection changes
quests.canonImpact: May reveal synthetic life within the asteroid.

quests.title: Not Cargo
quests.synopsis: Protect a newly awakened machine mind discovered inside a shipment of industrial parts.
objectives: Find a lawful guardian or independence path
outcomes: A new citizen joins or is deactivated
quests.canonImpact: Applies synthetic personhood precedent to trade cargo.
